kind: read-only existing-contract audit; no interpreter, edits or Git mutation
conclusion: A general object-field store payload to current state version to load-result relation is not yet expressed by the existing contracts.

evidence.relation: BindingDefinition/BindingRead payload relations are for LocalBindingValue environment slots; binding_validation requires that type and constrains ordinary-call token transfer. They are not general heap-field bindings.

StateAddressRefinement has site, owner, path, mode and coverage; it has no stored payload Use or load own-result relation. StateAccess.reference identifies the access reference, not the stored payload.
The existing validator preserves content_state_version_unverified for Reference/access content; ContentRead alone does not establish correspondence to the current materialization version.
RequestAssociationRead names the current request input and exact body/latent output roles; it does not assert unchanged fields since Create.

required_design_decisions: Reference the original access site, refinement effect ordinal, store owned payload Use and load own result; reuse original state SSA.
Define completion-specific NORMAL/RAISE establishment and partial-write invalidation, keeping result slots separate from landing positions.
Separate primitive storage slots from descriptors/custom/native access; names do not identify getter/setter behavior.
Keep alias writes, unknown calls/native effects, missing capture and budget truncation conservative; joins retain original guards, callers and complete source inventory.
CallEffectExpansion supplies an effect path but needs original stored-value relations to recover a payload source.
